chat_only: Chat only for now. Connect your computer and Persona can work on it for you.
help_add_why: Persona works on your computer for you: reading files, running commands, using Claude Code there. Connect one first; Mac, Windows and Linux all work.
help_add_how: In the hub's admin page, open Computers and choose Add computer. Follow the steps to install Persona Link on that computer; it connects by itself.
help_add_note: The admin page has its own password, and by default it only opens from the hub's own network. If it won't open, use a computer on that network. Once the computer connects, this updates by itself.
help_wake_body: {machine} is offline. It may be asleep, or Persona Link isn't running on it. Open the lid or wake it, and make sure Persona Link is running.
help_wake_after: Once it's back, this updates by itself.

help_install_after: Come back here once it's installed; this updates shortly after.
help_login_body: On {machine}, open Terminal, type this word, press Return and sign in once in the browser:
help_login_after: When you're signed in, come back and send a message.
help_what_body: Persona is your personal assistant. With a computer and a model connected, it can:
help_what_computer: Read files and run commands on your computer for you (it asks before it acts)
help_what_data: Look at your calendar, mail, Lark and inbox, sort things out and draft replies
help_what_memory: Remember what you talked about and pick it up next time
help_model_body: Persona needs a working model to answer. Pick one of two ways:
help_model_key: You have an API key: in Settings › Model providers, pick a provider and paste the key. It's tested for you.
help_model_claude: You already use Claude Code: sign in once on that computer, nothing else to fill in.
help_model_computer: Either way, the main chat still runs on one of your computers today: pasting an API key alone, without a computer, is not enough to start.
help_model_no_computer: You have no computer connected yet: add one first.
help_model_computer_not_ready: Your computer is not ready yet; sort that out first: {step}
